game.title: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
game.notes: Genesis Mode. Nintendo Switch has no native achievement/trophy system, and Legends: Arceus is confirmed the first core-series Pokémon game to release in only one unified version — no other platform, no version-exclusive split. No paid DLC or expansion pass was ever released for this game; the only post-launch content is the free v1.1.0 'Daybreak' update (Feb 2022), which added the Arceus postgame content and is treated as base-game content here since it has been a permanent free part of the game for years — there is no `dlc` block, unlike the last three games covered this session. Scope decisions: (1) PLA-019 (Shaymin) and PLA-020 (Darkrai) both require save data linked from entirely separate Pokémon games (Sword/Shield and Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl respectively) — included at explicit user request (who owns both prerequisite games), each marked missable with a note on the external-save dependency for any reader who doesn't. (2) PLA-026 (Pokédex completion) verifies via the Shiny Charm reward rather than citing an exact species count, since no source confirmed the game displays a numeric completion percentage anywhere — the Hisui Pokédex is a physical in-game book whose condition changes visually rather than showing a hard number. (3) A dossier-flagged detail was deliberately NOT turned into its own trophy: certain unique story Alpha Pokémon are reportedly permanently lost if defeated rather than caught, but which specific encounters this applies to beyond a loosely-sourced 'e.g. Alpha Kleavor' example could not be pinned down distinctly from the mandatory Noble Kleavor fight (which uses an unrelated balm-throwing mechanic, not a catch-or-defeat choice) — rather than risk conflating the two and writing a factually wrong trophy, no trophy references this missable Alpha content specifically. (4) Whether Giratina is caught or simply defeated after its battle could not be confirmed, so PLA-024's verification is written to hold true either way.

trophies.name: Beyond the Horizon
trophies.description: Arrive in Hisui and join the Galaxy Expedition Team.
trophies.verification: The opening story sequence concludes with the player enrolled as a Galaxy Expedition Team member in Jubilife Village.

trophies.name: Handmade
trophies.description: Craft an item at a crafting bench for the first time.
trophies.verification: The crafted item appears in the Satchel.

trophies.name: Field Notes
trophies.description: Complete your first Pokédex research task.
trophies.verification: The completed task is marked done on that species' Pokédex entry, raising its Research Level.

trophies.name: Mastered Technique
trophies.description: Master a move for the first time, unlocking its Strong Style or Agile Style version.
trophies.verification: The mastery icon appears next to the move on the Pokémon's summary and move-selection screens.

trophies.name: Room to Grow
trophies.description: Upgrade your Satchel for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Satchel menu shows an additional item slot.

trophies.name: Cut Above
trophies.description: Catch your first Alpha Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Alpha status icon appears on the caught Pokémon's summary screen.

trophies.name: A Glimmer in Hisui
trophies.description: Catch a Shiny Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Pokémon is added to the party or box with its distinct color and sparkle animation.

trophies.name: Lord of the Woods, Calmed
trophies.description: Calm Kleavor's frenzy and receive its Plate.
trophies.verification: Kleavor's frenzy gauge empties, triggering the mission's clear cutscene and adding the Plate to the Bag.

trophies.name: First Companion
trophies.description: Unlock your first Ride Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Ride Pokémon becomes available for traversal via the Satchel's ride menu.

trophies.name: Between Worlds
trophies.description: Enter an active Space-Time Distortion for the first time.
trophies.verification: Wild Pokémon in the area despawn and the distortion's aggressive spawn groups begin appearing.

trophies.name: Pop Champion
trophies.description: Play the balloon-popping minigame for the first time.
trophies.verification: A balloon-popping attempt concludes and its score/reward screen appears.

trophies.name: Picture Perfect
trophies.description: Take your first photo at the Photography Studio.
trophies.verification: The captured photo is shown on the studio's results screen.

trophies.name: Back in Good Graces
trophies.description: Defeat Commander Kamado and reconcile with the Galaxy Expedition Team.
trophies.verification: Kamado's defeat triggers his concession and the story's resolution cutscene.

trophies.name: Swarm Tactics
trophies.description: Catch a wild Pokémon during a Mass Outbreak.
trophies.verification: The Pokémon is caught while the Mass Outbreak icon is still active on the region map.

trophies.name: Five Lords Calmed
trophies.description: Calm all 5 Noble Pokémon: Kleavor, Lilligant, Arcanine, Electrode, and Avalugg.
trophies.verification: The Bag's Plate collection shows a Plate from each of the 5 Noble encounters.

trophies.name: Full Stable
trophies.description: Unlock all 5 Ride Pokémon: Wyrdeer, Ursaluna, Basculegion, Sneasler, and Braviary.
trophies.verification: The Satchel's ride menu shows all 5 Ride Pokémon available.

trophies.name: Voice of the Lakes
trophies.description: Complete the Trial of the Lakes and catch Dialga or Palkia in its normal Forme.
trophies.verification: The caught legendary is registered in the Pokédex.

trophies.name: Full Star
trophies.description: Reach Full Star (10-Star) Galaxy Team rank.
trophies.verification: Cyllene's dialogue confirms the Full Star rank has been recorded when spoken to in Jubilife Village.

trophies.name: A Gift From the Sky Fields
trophies.description: Complete the postgame request leading to Shaymin, using linked Pokémon Sword or Shield save data.
trophies.verification: Shaymin is added to the party or box.
trophies.notes: Requires a Nintendo Switch with linked Pokémon Sword or Shield save data present — an external ownership dependency (not a time-limited window) beyond owning this game alone. Included at explicit user request.

trophies.name: Nightmare's End
trophies.description: Complete the postgame request leading to Darkrai, using linked Pokémon Brilliant Diamond or Shining Pearl save data.
trophies.verification: Darkrai is added to the party or box.
trophies.notes: Requires a Nintendo Switch with linked Pokémon Brilliant Diamond or Shining Pearl save data present — an external ownership dependency (not a time-limited window) beyond owning this game alone. Included at explicit user request.

trophies.name: Perfect Entry
trophies.description: Reach 'Perfect' research status with a Pokémon species for the first time.
trophies.verification: The species' Pokédex entry displays the 'Perfect' status.

trophies.name: The Ancient Retreat
trophies.description: Discover Ancient Retreat and receive the Pixie Plate from Cogita.
trophies.verification: The Pixie Plate is added to the Bag after bringing Cogita 3 pieces of wood.

trophies.name: Master of Time and Space
trophies.description: Catch the Origin Forme counterpart of Dialga or Palkia atop Mount Coronet, resolving the space-time rift.
trophies.verification: The Origin Forme legendary is registered in the Pokédex and the main story's resolution cutscene plays.

trophies.name: The Merchant's True Face
trophies.description: Defeat Volo and Giratina in the postgame confrontation at the Temple of Sinnoh.
trophies.verification: Giratina's defeat ends the encounter and Volo surrenders the Spooky Plate.

trophies.name: Keeper of Plates
trophies.description: Obtain all 18 Plates.
trophies.verification: The Bag's Plate collection screen shows all 18 Plates present.

trophies.name: Hisui's Pokémon Professor
trophies.description: Complete the Hisui Pokédex.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Charm is granted by Cyllene, confirming Research Level 10 has been reached for every required species.

trophies.name: Test of the Original One
trophies.description: Play the Azure Flute at the Temple of Sinnoh and catch Arceus at the Hall of Origin.
trophies.verification: Arceus is added to the party or box following its defeat at the Hall of Origin.

trophies.name: Undefeated
trophies.description: Reach a 50-battle winning streak in the Eternal Battle Reverie and defeat Arceus.
trophies.verification: The win-streak counter shown during the Eternal Battle Reverie reaches battle 50 against Arceus, and its defeat is recorded.

trophies.name: Sovereign of Hisui
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.
